headline_measurement.protocol: MiniWob++, all 130 tasks, 3 reps, 390 trials. Held-out split = the 90 tasks never used for any tuning decision across r130-r160.
headline_measurement.reading: The held-out gain exceeds the literature noise floor (median run-to-run SD 1.5 pp, arXiv 2602.07150). The seen-set decline is not interpretable at this n. The number that means something is the held-out one, and it moved.

defects_fixed_the_same_shape_three_times.class: a status field that says yes when the payload says no
defects_fixed_the_same_shape_three_times.one: resolve() returned status RESOLVED with a choice carrying no cx/cy. On email-inbox it returned a choice with no cx/cy at all; on another page it returned declared='click canvas' at (245,105) -- the instruction text. Guard: RESOLVED requires a pressable point, else UNCLICKABLE.
defects_fixed_the_same_shape_three_times.two: plan_reference extracted the target and discarded the anchor. 'Find the email by Jeniece and click the star icon' planned [{'kind':'RELATION','value':'star','by':'shape'}]. resolve_scope(anchor,target) existed and was called by nothing in this shape -- the FOURTH unreachable door this session after _try_explore (r147), discover, and answer_query (r156). Routing rule: SCOPE first for '<verb> ... by <Name> ... <control> icon'.
defects_fixed_the_same_shape_three_times.three: resolve_scope matched the target on own-text equality. <span class='star'> has own text ''. Now declared names (class/aria/title/alt/id) match on word boundaries INSIDE the anchor, only when exactly one element carries the name.

the_noise_floor_measured_in_this_session.consequence: A single-task 12-rep result is NOT evidence of a change when both readings sit inside 6-10/12. click-color 3/3 -> 0/3 in the 130-run is one draw, not a regression. The A/B that said 7/12 vs 8/12 was also noise.
the_noise_floor_measured_in_this_session.law_added: Before calling a per-task change a regression or a fix, measure the unchanged code three times on that same task. If the readings disagree with each other, the task cannot arbitrate.

still_not_solved: email-inbox-reply 0/12 -- the reply flow needs typing into a reply box after opening the message
the held-out number is 0.2000, not a capability claim
